name: dryrun_01_marrakesh_pipeline_check
notes: Pre-registration Q1 v0.4, Section 6 (Minute budget): 'Pipeline checks (transpilation, job submission, logging, result parsing) therefore run on ibm_marrakesh under the open plan at no Flex cost'; also Paper 2 pre-registration Gate P2-1 (c): 'The Marrakesh dry run completes end to end, every row parses, and reset survives transpilation as a distinct instruction' and Section 3b kill rule (c) (a measure count above the terminal readout means reset was compiled to measure-plus-conditional-X). Smallest end-to-end run of the Paper 1 pipeline: one 2x5 patch (n = 10), L = 2, k = 1, M = 5 draws, 1024 shots, resilience 0 and 1 (two Estimator jobs), plus two probe jobs: a shifted pair with a mid-circuit native reset after each layer (p = 0.5, one mask) and its delay(400 ns)-matched control. The per-job bundle records the ISA instruction names, the measure count, the reset/delay counts and the target durations (circuits.json) and backend.default_rep_delay / rep_delay_range (job.json). The patch is placed with the ibm_phoenix snapshot (2x5 at origin (9,1): qubits 91-95, 101-105, edge 93_103) and used as initial_layout on Marrakesh's heavy-hex map, so the router inserts SWAPs: depth and CZ counts here check the pipeline, not the device. Target at most 3 open-plan minutes (estimate in budget). Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is TBD.

probes.purpose: what the transpiler emits for a mid-circuit native reset (ISA name, measure count, scheduled duration)
same mask with delay(400 ns) in place of reset: what the transpiler emits for the delay (dt units, duration)

budget.formula: 2 s per job + (rep_delay + L x 0.71 us + 1.94 us readout [+ dial durations]) x executions
